experimental_design: we measured protein and phosphorylation site changes across 11 points of a time course and developed a method for categorizing phosphorylation site behavior relative to protein level changes using the diauxic shift in yeast as a model and TMT11 sample multiplexing.
number_of_fractions: Assuming that adjacent fractions contain overlapping peaks, only 12 nonadjacent samples were analyzed using the mass spectrometer.
number_of_samples: we measured protein and phosphorylation site changes across 11 points of a time course and developed a method for categorizing phosphorylation site behavior relative to protein level changes using the diauxic shift in yeast as a model and TMT11 sample multiplexing.
technology_type: TMT11 multiplexing with SPS-MS3 mass spectrometry
Each analysis used an SPS-MS3-based TMT method, which has been shown to reduce ion interference compared to MS2-based quantification.
